x: We are greatly indebted to our two Vice-Presidents Albert and Gus Macher for a generous donation which will renew the useful life of the Macher shield for another generation.

News comes from Albert Macher that he is progressing after a period of ill-health which prevented him from coming along recently to present the Macher Shield for the 10 Miles Championship, Albert and his brother Gus, belong to that very select band of members who joined the Club prior to World War I…

It is with sorrow that we record the deaths of Albert and Gus Macher, Vice Presidents of the Club for many years, and members since 1912. Albert was also a Life Member, an honour accorded him for his many services to the Club and in appreciation of his work as Hon.
